description: This file implements the 'Details' feature for articles within the Conduit project, including a query, validation, and handler to retrieve article details based on a slug.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates the query parameters, ensuring the 'Slug' is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the request to retrieve article details from the database based on the provided slug.

methods.name: QueryValidator()
methods.description: Constructs the validator with rules for 'Slug'.

methods.name: Handle()
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the article by slug and throws a not found exception if absent.
